summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Portfolio CMS. 20/20 pytest backend tests passed. Frontend public pages, project detail, admin login/session/CRUD flows verified end-to-end. No critical issues found. Test data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: CORS is 'allow_origins=*' with allow_credentials=True — most browsers reject cookies with wildcard. Currently works because frontend and backend share the same origin (ingress), but change CORS_ORIGINS in backend/.env to explicit domain(s) for production safety.

auth.py: brute-force lock key is per (client_ip + username). Behind ingress/proxy, request.client.host will be the proxy IP, so all users share the same lock bucket. Consider using X-Forwarded-For or trusting proxy headers.
seed_admin(): only creates the admin if it doesn't exist. If ADMIN_PASSWORD env var is rotated, the existing admin's hash is NOT updated (per playbook it should upsert password on change).
routes_content.py _prepare_project: slug uniqueness only checks against one existing clash. If the fallback slug also clashes, no further disambiguation happens.
repository.MongoRepository.list: hard-coded to_list(1000) limit — fine for portfolio, but should be documented.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — all TEST_* records were created and immediately deleted. Profile hero_subtitle was modified and reverted to original.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 20 tests: auth, public portfolio, CRUD for skills/tools/experiences/projects, profile, upload image/CV). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend admin dashboard route is /admin (index, not /admin/dashboard). Verified: public Home (hero, about, experience, projects, contact), ProjectDetail (title, cover, overview, role, tools, palette with 5 swatches, typography, gallery, outcome, related, back-link), project-not-found for unknown slug, mobile 390px shows nav-menu-toggle and no horizontal overflow, admin login/wrong-password/session-persist-after-refresh/logout, Skills add+delete, Profile save+revert, Experience add+delete via dialog, Project create (auto-slug) + delete, Settings change-password with wrong current returns error. All test data cleaned up.
